# IU Study Time Manager

A comprehensive study time management application for students.

## About

IU Study Time Manager helps students track their study sessions, set goals, manage calendar events, and monitor their academic progress.

## Features

- Study time tracking and timer
- Goal setting and progress monitoring
- Calendar integration with ICS import
- Achievement system
- Statistics and analytics
- Multi-language support (German/English)
- Dark/Light theme
- Progressive Web App (PWA) capabilities

## Stack

- Built with TypeScript, React, and TanStack Router
- Backend powered by Bun and Nitro
- Database with Drizzle ORM
- Styled with Tailwind CSS
